intro: Meet Davy—the corner table that does more than just fill a space. With its playful charm, sleek glass top, and handy storage, it turns any corner into a stylish and functional focal point.

features.title: A pop of personality for your space
features.text: With its vibrant, modern design, Davy adds a stylish touch that blends effortlessly with any interior, making every corner feel special.

features.title: Storage that keeps up with you
features.text: Keep essentials within arm’s reach! The dual-shelf design offers a perfect mix of practicality and style, making clutter a thing of the past.

features.title: Clear, sturdy, and made to impress
features.text: Sleek and durable, the toughened glass top brings sophistication while ensuring lasting strength—perfect for showcasing your favorite decor pieces.

features.title: Low maintenance, high style
features.text: Effortless to clean, Davy’s materials ensure you spend less time scrubbing and more time enjoying its style and practicality.

features.title: Designed to fit, wherever you need it
features.text: Designed to fit snugly into corners, Davy maximises space without compromising on usability, making it a must-have for cosy homes.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
